name: Skali's Fine Armour, Front Room
desc1: This large, stark room is filled with armour pieces made of chain and
desc2: steel. A squat, brooding gnome stands up as you approach, and golden
desc3: chains jangle at his movement. He is cloaked in heavy purple robes,
desc4: and is covered in a king's ransom worth of jewelry. The shop continues
desc5: to the west, where you can hear a loud ringing of metal on metal. You
desc6: can exit to the east and south.
